name: Account hacked and locked out
description: Users cannot log in because their account appears hacked, and support channels are not resolving the access problem.

name: General app access failures
description: Users report the app stops working, logs them out, or refuses to open or accept their phone number after updates.

name: Unable to log in
description: Users are logged out unexpectedly or cannot sign in to their existing accounts despite trying.

name: Login fails despite password reset
description: Users cannot log in even after resetting their password, with incorrect password errors persisting.

name: Cannot create or sign up
description: New users cannot complete account sign-up, getting errors or repeated prompts instead of a working account.

name: Charged after cancelling or unable to pay
description: Users are charged after cancelling or cannot complete payment, and report being left without working access.

name: Payment and paywall frustrations
description: Users report being pushed toward premium, failing to pay in-app with "unable to connect" errors, and losing basic playback without a subscription.

name: Free tier features locked behind premium
description: Free users find core playback features restricted and heavy ads, while paid users sometimes see inconsistent subscription status.

name: Premium price seen as too high
description: Users feel the premium subscription is too expensive for the value, especially alongside ads and bugs.

name: Subscription changes cause access loss
description: Users lose family or premium plans after changing payment details, or cannot start an individual subscription.

name: Song selection and matching errors
description: Users report wrong songs playing, search results missing or mismatched, and restricted artist catalogues.

name: Lyrics not loading or missing
description: Users report that lyrics fail to load or have disappeared from songs they play.

name: Songs and shows unavailable
description: Users find songs, specials, or features that were previously available have been removed or are unavailable in their region.

name: Podcast and audiobook gaps
description: Users report missing podcast history, unavailable audiobooks or video podcasts, and podcast playback problems.

name: Recommendations override chosen playlists
description: Users say the app plays recommended songs instead of the playlists they selected, and offline playback of downloads stalls.

name: Search returns nothing
description: Users cannot find songs or artists through search, which often shows no results or fails to load.

name: Downloads fail or won't save
description: Users cannot download music, or downloads fail to save to storage or require a subscription first.

name: Downloaded music vanishes
description: Users find their downloaded songs and playlists gone after updates or time passing, with no fix from support.

name: Local files and storage problems
description: Users have trouble adding local files, saving to SD cards, and syncing playlists across devices.

name: Offline playback fails
description: Users find downloaded music will not play offline, or offline mode times out or disappears entirely.

name: Miscellaneous app breakdowns
description: Users report the app stopped working or was compromised, with vague complaints not tied to a specific feature.

name: No sound or poor audio quality
description: Users hear no sound from music, distorted or low-quality audio, or volume problems while other apps work fine.

name: Launch failures and heavy resource use
description: The app fails to launch even after clearing cache, drains battery, or uses excessive storage and background data.

name: False no-internet errors
description: Users see "no internet connection" messages or endless loading even when their network and other apps work fine.

name: App crashes or won't open
description: Users report the app crashing repeatedly, closing unexpectedly, or refusing to open after updates.

name: Playback fails to start
description: Users report music will not play or load, sometimes requiring reinstalls, with no clear cause.

name: Slow loading and stuck screens
description: The app loads slowly or freezes on a logo or black screen, and songs or playlists take ages to start.

name: Playback stops unexpectedly
description: Songs stop randomly, cannot be skipped, or exit the app during playback, particularly after updates.

name: Support is slow or unhelpful
description: Users find customer support unhelpful, slow to respond, or stuck in loops, and report problems with support features like email.

name: Ads interrupt free listening
description: Free users face frequent ads, including ads mid-song, and limited listening time before ads resume.

name: Navigation and display glitches
description: Users encounter blank screens, awkward navigation, and playback that does not match what they tapped.

name: Playlists play wrong or stop
description: Users find playlists stop after one song, skip to unrelated music, or fail to show their chosen tracks and genres.

name: Shuffle and skip controls restricted
description: Users cannot skip, rewind, or choose songs freely, and shuffle or car mode changes make controls harder to use.

name: Disliked new interface design
description: Users say the redesigned interface is hard to use or crashes the app, and they want the earlier design back.
